title: Puzzle 2d Play Tree Hover Flicker
description: Fix puzzle 2d play document tree items flashing hover→selected→unselected when pointer leaves rows while only hovering.
summary: Fixed puzzle 2d play document hover flicker: Tree `highlightedIds` rows now use `bg-hover-base` instead of sharing selection `bg-active-base`, and row pointer-leave no longer clears hover when moving into nested branch content.
